reviewer: Codex independent senior technical editor sub-agent (AI)
scope: Full variance manuscript only; other three manuscripts were not complete and were not reviewed as full manuscripts.

issues.quote: 每一列都是下一列的前提
issues.problem: CLI success is not a prerequisite for artifact success, and the failure row is not a subsequent stage. The prose contradicts the possible CLI-false/artifact-true outcome described at line 59.
issues.revision: Explain that the table separately reports all planned slots, CLI completion, artifact acceptance, and their intersection. Rename the first column from 階段 to 名額與結果欄位; explicitly state that these are not consecutive filtering stages.

issues.quote: 表示每一份都保留了大量原本的骨架
issues.problem: Node-type count cosine demonstrates similar proportions, not the amount of retained source code. The inference contradicts the metric limits explained earlier.
issues.revision: State that the node-type proportions remain similar, that the common seed may contribute to high similarity, and that the study did not quantify retained original code or subtract shared scaffolding.

issues.quote: 任何一對候選之間的 cosine
issues.problem: Only 180 within-arm pairs were computed; the phrase also includes unreported cross-arm pairs.
issues.revision: Limit both sentences to the 180 within-arm pairs actually computed: 在本輪計算的 180 個組內 pair 中，最低的 cosine 仍高於 40 份候選各自相對 seed 的最高值。

issues.quote: 分子與分母剛好沒有落差
issues.problem: The numerator is cost and the denominator is accepted task count; their units cannot be described as having no gap.
issues.revision: Say there were no failed or abandoned slots, so every formal generation cost came from an accepted slot and the data cannot show how failed-generation costs raise average cost per successful task.

issues.quote: References 1–6 show repository paths as inline code without links
issues.problem: Readers cannot follow the promised path from reported IDs to source artifacts. Section back-pointers are present and should be retained.
issues.revision: Use valid relative Markdown links in the repository manuscript and confirmed public URLs in the publishing workflow. Point R01–R13 to the frozen archive source/requirements.json rather than a mutable working copy.

issues.quote: 本篇的每一個數字都只來自正式的四十個名額
issues.problem: The article also reports pilot/probe counts, tool tests, audit checks, and external research values.
issues.revision: Limit the statement to the four arms' acceptance, structural, and resource results: 下文四組的驗收、結構與資源結果，只採計正式的四十個名額。

issues.quote: 差異只能在 AST 層次看見
issues.problem: A single-file task can still differ in text, diagnostics, and behavior. The article turns its choice of descriptor into a universal observation limit.
issues.revision: State that file count cannot distinguish the candidates, so this study chose AST descriptors to describe internal structural differences.

required_followup: Verify E01–E07 against a new variance hash and reread its second half; review the other three complete manuscripts and cross-article division before issuing any series-ready verdict.
